title: Unleash Beast (staff)
body:
Syntax: unleash beast

Description: (Staff only.) Releases a random Tailed Beast into the world -- picked from whichever of the 9 real beasts (Shukaku through Kurama) isn't currently sealed into some player, online or offline. A released beast spawns somewhere random (never in a safe room), roams on its own every 10-15 minutes, attacks any player it encounters, and despawns after 2 hours if nobody defeats or seals it. Announces globally which beast was released, so every player knows one is loose.

Only one Tailed Beast can be loose in the world at a time -- refuses if a beast is already out there, and also refuses if every single beast is already held by a player.

Date: 2026-09-06
